title: Two days on Con Dao
summary: The first day is the camps and Hàng Dương, on foot in town. The second day is the park, then the boat toward Hòn Bảy Cạnh.

days.title: Day 1 — The camps and Hàng Dương
days.body: Walk the camps as one site, then Hàng Dương. The night market on Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng starts at 17:00.

days.title: Day 2 — The park and the islets
days.body: Give the day to the park, then the boat toward Hòn Bảy Cạnh. The boat from the town jetty takes about 45 minutes, and time on the islet is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Con Dao prison

approach.note: In town, to số 02 Nguyễn Huệ.

stops.note: Walk the yards and the tiger cages as one site in town.

stops.name: Hang Duong cemetery

approach.note: In town, at a separate gate from the camps.

stops.note: Walk the four grave zones after the camps.

stops.name: Con Dao National Park
stops.note: Give the day to a forest walk or a boat, on a ticket separate from the camps.

stops.name: Hon Bay Canh
stops.note: Walk the nesting beach and the hill after the boat.

seoTitle: Two days on Con Dao — camps, then the park
seoDescription: Day one is the prison camps and Hàng Dương. Day two is the park and the boat toward Hòn Bảy Cạnh, about 45 minutes from the town jetty.
